title: Siremis v5.3.0 Released
html:
Siremis v5.3.0 is out – the open source web management interface for Kamailio SIP Server.

This version comes with major changes and many new features, among them the removal of legacy flash charts (now uses pure JS), make the code compatible with PHP 7.x and web views to manage many new modules added up to Kamailio v5.3.x, including the replacement of MI control interface with JSONRPC. This is the first full release in 5.x series of Siremis.

Step by step installation tutorial, screenshots and changelog are available on the web at:

  • Installation Tutorial
  • Screenshots
  • ChangeLog

The deployment of Siremis can be also done using Docker, see the guidelines at:

  • https://github.com/asipto/siremis/tree/master/misc/docker

Siremis project is hosted on Github at:

  • https://github.com/asipto/siremis/

Do not forget about the next Kamailio World Conference, April 27-29, 2020, in Berlin, Germany! The first group of speakers has been announced, the schedule in under work, news about the event agenda to be released very soon! See you there!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
